svg.aria-label: Increment a counter, on disk. Add 1 to a counter that converges when replicas increment it concurrently. Each library's own persistence on node:fs, every write awaited. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: syncom (the pure build: only its text is typed through openText()); Yjs (no counter that converges); Yjs (memory only — on disk the Yjs row stores every update already); Loro (memory only — on disk the Loro row appends every update already); TinyBase (no counter that converges); PouchDB (no counter that converges); RxDB (Node.js disk storages are Premium); Fireproof (no counter that converges); GUN (no counter that converges); OrbitDB (no counter that converges).
